headline: Moody's upgrades mining company to Baa2 on strong uranium demand
summary: Moody's upgraded Global Mining Corp to Baa2 from Baa3. Outlook stable. Driven by robust uranium market fundamentals and improved cash flow.

headline: Energy Corp files 8-K on uranium mining license approval
summary: Energy Corp (NYSE: ENGY) announced regulatory approval for uranium mining operations in Wyoming. Expected production: 2M lbs/year.

headline: US Treasury imposes new sanctions on Iranian energy entities
summary: OFAC designated 12 entities involved in Iranian petroleum trade. Restrictions effective immediately.

headline: Critical Minerals Inc. announces $500M financing for lithium project
summary: Critical Minerals Inc. secured $500M in project financing from JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs for lithium extraction facility in Nevada.

headline: COT Report: Large speculators increase gold net long positions
summary: Non-commercial traders increased net long gold positions by 15% week-over-week, reaching highest level since 2020.

headline: URA sees $250M inflow amid uranium supply concerns
summary: Global X Uranium ETF (URA) recorded $250M inflow over past week. Year-to-date inflows now exceed $1.2B.

headline: Gold breaks above $2,100/oz on geopolitical tensions
summary: Gold prices surged 2.5% to reach $2,120/oz amid escalating Middle East tensions and safe-haven demand.
